example.area_note: Separate 4000 sqft podium, 6000 sqft tower and 2500 sqft open-space footprints occupy a 12500 sqft parcel.

allocation_policy.subsidized_amenities: Five mid-career, five general and five attainable apartments in the tower; one cafe and one greengrocer on the ground floor. Hospital excluded.
allocation_policy.outdoor: One playground resized to 2500 sqft, occupying the full open-space allotment as requested.
allocation_policy.filler: One 10000 sqft lab suite, five luxury apartments and up to 12000 sqft office; unused capacity is retained.

example.limitations: Synthetic floor-area allocation; fractional tower floors allowed. Construction cost includes hard and soft costs, excluding land and financing; tower area is capped at 30 stories independently of bonuses, with a separate five-story podium.

catalog.program_description: Laboratory program with no per-use upper area limit; specialized layout must be checked.
Classroom-based adult education and career training; no large specialist workshops.
Neighborhood branch library with reading, collection, computer and meeting space.
Local public-service office; not an entire government department.
One ground-floor market bay; aggregate area limited by ground-floor footprint.
Small gallery or performance venue including support space.
Pocket park; competes with playground for dedicated open space.
One compact playground using the dedicated open-space allotment.

preference/annual-surplus.limitations: Stabilized model; provisional capitalization rates; negative NOI capitalized as an ongoing liability; simplified common area basis; no financing, vacancy, transaction costs, construction timing, floor-plan packing, or mechanical floors. Valuation is an estimate, not an additional cash receipt. Land excluded unless enabled. Objective choice remains provisional.

break_even.method: Exactly the minimum package of one amenity plus luxury housing; whole units and optimal placement. Break-even means matching the no-amenity development profit. Total bonus includes existing area refund. Other amenities excluded. Negative NOI capitalized as developer liability; no city subsidy. 4.5% capitalization rate provisional. No changes to bonus assumptions.
